scientific_integrity: An analytical proof and a finite supplementary checker are supplied. Numerical finite compressions are not substituted for the infinite-dimensional argument. Publication priority and correctness have not undergone independent review.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires a positive finite limit of the quadratic row moduli; it gives singular-value asymptotics, not a complete spectrum. Older discrete weighted-Hardy spectral literature may imply an equivalent formula under different language, and the historical 1982 article was not available in full.
title: A beta-quarter Weyl law for quadratic Rhaly rows and Cesàro shift defects
